traps.label: "Dolly and the DJ / Most Saturday Nights" and "Sunday afternoons / come hang with the friendly bears 2-6pm" - two undated blurbs in one text block at the bottom of /events
traps.why: Where run 20260909-072307's 12 "dated" events came from, on a site with zero dated listings: (a) /events blurbs, 3 records - "Trivia Taco night" 2026-09-29 with FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=-1TU (the cancelled last-Tuesday exception read as the rule), "Queeraoke" 2026-09-09 20:30 WEEKLY;WE (fine), and this kept record "Dolly and the DJ" 2026-09-12T21:00Z-2026-09-13T01:00Z = Saturday 14:00-18:00 local with FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=SA, description "come hang with the friendly bears 2-6pm" and isBearEvent true: title and weekday from the Saturday blurb, time and description from the Sunday blurb, bear verdict earned by the Sunday blurb's words - a chimera that puts a drag/DJ night on the bear calendar and erases the actual Sunday bear social; (b) the 2026-09-07 homepage cache, 2 records - "BRUNCH 11-2pm" (kept, see homepage-sunday-brunch-11-2pm) and a second Queeraoke that dedup folded into (a)'s ("1 duplicate removed"); (c) /mothly-events flyers, 6 records - EXPOSED 2026-09-11, SHOWTUNES 2026-10-01, Drink & Draw 2026-09-29, GAY BINGO 2026-09-24 (4TH only), RAT CITY HONKY TONK 2026-10-02, CHOPPER 'N' FRIENDS 2026-09-19 (kept) - each a legitimate monthly rule with its next occurrence materialized, GAME ON! missed; (d) an off-site ticketleap page, 1 record - "Queer Art Market" 2025-03-22 (see ticketleap-queer-art-market-2025). Total 3+2+6+1 = 12 = the run's totalEvents. The dates are all rule arithmetic from undated text; none is a listed instance. This trap is the fused Saturday record specifically: it must not exist. The two blurbs are documented separately as dolly-and-the-dj and south-seattle-bear-social-sunday.

traps.label: /upcoming-events - page title "Brunch Menu | lumberyardbar", nav label "Brunch Menu"
traps.why: The slug promises an events list; the page is the brunch menu (two photographed menu cards: Short Stack $11, The Fabulous B $15, Biscuits and Gravy $16, Pride Breakfast Burger $18 ...) over the shared footer. Static and rendered agree, and the 2026-09-07 page cache is the same. The sitemap lists it, the crawler fetched it (page cache upcoming-events.json), and nothing on it is an event. Any record with "Brunch" or a menu price as a title from this URL is a menu, not programming.

Run 20260909-072307 followed the link, classified it "event-page" and extracted "Queer Art Market" startDate 2025-03-22T21:00Z (raw 2025-03-22T14:00:00-0700) with endDate 2026-10-18T01:00Z, ticketUrl events.ticketleap.com/tickets/thelumberyardbarcom/queer-art-market, cover from JSON-LD offers; the bear check dropped it. The link no longer exists on the live homepage, and the parser sets no allowPastEvents, so this must not be extracted.

traps.label: Wix Events & Tickets app (events-viewer widget, "events" / "events_members_page" ids in the site model) with zero events
traps.why: The site model advertises the Wix Events app, which is the door a Wix-aware scraper would query first. The app is installed but empty: the Wix Events API answers total=0 with an empty events array, and no /event-details or events-list page is in the sitemap. Treat any "events viewer" data path on this host as an empty shell, not as proof that the site publishes nothing - the real inventory is the blurbs on /events and the flyers on /mothly-events.

traps.why: The strip is an undated weekday grid (no dates, no month), not the dated schedule seen on 2026-09-07. Its two filled cells are documented as series (taco-tuesday-happy-hour, sunday-brunch); the empty weekday headings must not become events.
